holes_in_opposing_case: FACT: 1m CORRA is still 2.2875/2.305/2.43/2.58 through Dec-26 (+29bp) while 3m Mar-27 is 3.13 (+84bp) and Jun/Sep 2027 are already 3.365/3.51. INFERENCE: carry-is-king, positioning-cynic and rate-dove treat the existence of an 84–130bp 2027 strip as proof that catch-up is already paid. That is the wrong tenor. The priced assumption being tested is the on-hold near strip, not whether some 2027 hikes exist. Receiving H–Z harvests the later contracts that already embed more catch-up; Mar-27 is the cheap pull-forward contract. UNKNOWN: whether BoC skips one meeting; delay is not the same as the 1m strip remaining on-hold.

FACT: Canada headline CPI is 3%, BoC minutes already flag energy pass-through, Brent 130.8 / WTI 107.02 sit at 96–100th 1y percentiles as of 15 Sep, and CA activity is 66 versus labor 38. INFERENCE: the receive-Canada invalidation that requires trim/median to leave 1.9–2.0% AND the strip to hold 3.40/3.13 because BoC ‘delivers’ is a stacked bar. Headline and minutes already put pass-through in the reaction function; labor-scare pricing after a 17 Sep CA 2Y/10Y 8–9bp rally is using known softness to justify a new easing impulse. Looking through energy because core is near 2% is the market’s assumption, not an unowned forecast.

FACT: CORRA open interest is null and CME positioning is unavailable. INFERENCE: positioning-cynic cannot call the energy-hawk BoC cycle the crowded book in CRA. The observable book is CAD leveraged-fund covering of +16426 to a 99.0th 1y percentile of net, with residual shorts still −39022. That is covering into CAD, not a documented pay-Canada futures pile-up. Fading ‘crowded hiking’ without CRA OI is a narrative overlay on a missing dataset.

FACT: CA-US 2Y is already −140bp (about 4th percentile 1y/5y) and overnight SOFR–CORRA is 156bp, while USDCAD is only 74th 1y / 87th 5y after +1.74% 1m and still −1.25% 3m; packet USDCAD vs CA-US 2Y r^2 is 0.022. INFERENCE: dollar-king’s claim that the policy gap is already extreme in rates so the residual is long USDCAD is an expression error. An already-extreme rates gap plus a weak FX–rates link is not a signal to add CAD-lower; it is a reason the CAD residual lives in CORRA catch-up, not in chasing USD after a delivered hike that USDCAD already embeds. CFTC covering and WTI 107.02 make a USD/CAD squeeze the dirtier side.

FACT: US activity/labor/consumer/inflation gauges are 69/75/74/72, August CPI kept a tightening bias, SOFR is 3.85, SR3H7 is 4.58 and SR3U7 is 4.755. INFERENCE: mean-reverter’s receive-Mar-27-SOFR ‘hike-was-priced, oil-tail reduced’ fade undercuts the same global impulse the 2022-06-30 / 2023-04-14 CA 2Y analogs continued through. A Saudi STS workaround is not a US labor/inflation break. Receiving leftover US overlay is a different discrepancy and does not make Canada the easy outlier.

FACT: rate-hawk and trend-follower agree the delivered Fed hike and hot US gauges keep 2027 SOFR bid, yet tag CAD lower. INFERENCE: that CAD-down is USD-exceptionalism mixed with CA labor 38, not a Canada-policy residual. If US tightening and energy leak north, the laggard is BoC path (CORRA 2.29, 1m +29bp by Dec), not a requirement that CAD sell versus USD. Their own expression notes say USDCAD mixes oil/BoC/covering; they then still export CAD-down as a view. Pay Mar-27 CORRA owns the leak without needing CAD weaker in spot.

FACT: AUDCAD is a 5y extreme (0.9976, 99.96th) while AU housing is contracting and AONIA 4.35 already exceeds CORRA 2.29 by 206bp. INFERENCE: cross-merchant’s short AUDCAD is a CAD-higher cross, not a refutation of paying CORRA. The 5y stretch is an AU-housing mapping error; it does not prove 2027 CRA is rich. Round-1 already rejected long AUD after the housing slump. A non-USD cross can coexist with Mar-27 catch-up; it does not substitute for the policy-path tenor.

FACT: value-guy pays CRA 2027 H1 versus receiving SR3, matching CA rates higher but mixing in receive-US duration. INFERENCE: that RV needs US 2027 implied to cheapen while CORRA richens. Packet US gauges and a just-delivered hike do not license the receive-SOFR leg as the cyclical expression. Peer-gap compression can occur by Canada catching up with US yields still firm; receiving SOFR is optional and fights the live tightening impulse.

FACT: NZ official rates are unavailable (HTTP 403), NZ labor is 32, NZ inflation gauge is 80, Q2 GDP 0.2% q/q beat, and an India FTA passed; AUDNZD’s 5y extreme is NZD-collapse-driven. INFERENCE: NZD-lower from dollar-king/rate-dove/rate-hawk/trend-follower is a USD-up hitchhike, not an identified RBNZ path. Vol-convexity’s NZD-up options view is directionally closer to a risk-on residual but is untradeable (premium/IV null, paper HOLD) and is not the Canada discrepancy. Missing NZ rates is why NZD is a view, not the book.
attack: Strongest opposing claim: 2027 CORRA already prices 84–130bp of BoC catch-up against trim/median 1.9–2.0%, employment −42k and labor 38, so the energy/Fed-hike narrative is owned and the holding-period trade is to receive the strip / sell CAD.

That claim fails a tenor test. The 1m path is still on-hold into October (+1.5bp) and only ~one 25bp by December. Mar-27 at 3.13 is below Jun-27 3.365 and Sep-27 3.51. Receiving the back of a curve that already prices more hikes is fading pull-forward, not harvesting unowned premium.

It also fails triangulation: activity 66, copper 6.615 (96.8th), SPX 7638, HY OAS 270bp, VIX 15.44, Brent/WTI at the top of the 1y distribution, and a delivered Fed/BoJ tightening impulse are not a Canadian recession set. Labor 38 is real but known; the new path is the 17 Sep sovereign rally after SOFR jumped to 3.85.
Ownership claims are inverted. CRA OI/CME positioning are null. Available CFTC is CAD short-covering to a 99th 1y net percentile — a headwind to CAD-lower, not evidence that paying Canada is crowded.

CAD-lower/USDCAD-long and receive-SOFR are inferior expressions of the same global-hawk tape: the CA-US 2Y gap is already a 4th-percentile cheap-Canada print, USDCAD–2Y r^2 is 0.022, and US gauges have not broken. Those seats are arguing expression and USD exceptionalism, not that Canada activity collapsed.
NZD-lower is unidentified. No NZ policy path exists in the packet; GDP beat and FTA are the opposite of a fresh NZD-down catalyst. AUDNZD convexity is not a Canada rates substitute.
defense: FACT vs INFERENCE vs UNKNOWN: Global tightening is delivered (Fed +25bp, SOFR 3.85, BoJ 1.25%, BoE 6-3 with three hike votes) while US gauges and cyclical assets are not in recession. Canada is priced as the exception (CORRA 2.29, 1m +29bp by Dec-26, 17 Sep CA 2Y/10Y rally). Inference stands: energy pass-through plus activity 66 make that exception too large; Mar-27 should be pulled toward already-higher 2027 CRA mids. Unknown remains whether the Saudi workaround and core-near-2% let BoC wait through Q1.

Rates remain cleaner than short USDCAD: CORRA 2.29 vs SOFR 3.85 is negative carry in spot, USDCAD already embeds the 16 Sep hike, and CAD covering is extended. Cross-merchant AUDCAD-short is a separate AU-housing stretch, not the BoC path. Value-guy’s receive-SOFR / pay-CORRA RV dilutes the laggard-bank view with a US-duration fade the hot US gauges do not support.

Carry opposing the trade is acknowledged, not fatal: this is a path-pull-forward, not a coupon harvest versus 3.85% SOFR vig. Size stays $50m of $100m because labor 38, core near 2%, and +84bp already in CRAH27 cut conviction.

Would concede if CORRA_2027-03 implied revisits the packet 2.775 Dec-26 3m mid, or if subsequent packet BoC/CPI/labor evidence confirms core stays near 2% with fading energy pass-through and activity rolling over from 66. A skipped meeting while 1m still refuses to price November is delay, not invalidation. Analog risk is also preserved: 2026-04-01 was a fade after a similar +31bp 1m CA 2Y backup, but that analog had no just-delivered Fed hike and no 99th-percentile Brent print.

US 2Y rose to 4.76 (1d +9bp, 1m +57bp) and US 10Y to 5.01. Canada did the opposite after the hike: CA 2Y 3.27 (1d -8bp, z -1.86) and CA 10Y 3.83 (1d -9bp, z -2.20). Brent 130.8 and WTI 107.02 as of 15 Sep; Saudi workaround 16 Sep reduced the extreme oil-supply tail while prices eased modestly.
context_build.known_vs_new_information: KNOWN before the 16 Sep FOMC: August US CPI kept a tightening bias, hike odds were already >90%, Canada August CPI was 3% with core near 2%, BoC minutes had already flagged energy pass-through, and CA labor/consumer gauges were soft (38/45). NEW in the path: the hike was delivered, SOFR printed 3.85, Canada sovereigns rallied the next session instead of following US yields, and the 1m CORRA strip still prices almost no move before November. The known labor-softness narrative is being used to justify a new CAD-rates easing impulse after a global hike.

That requires Canadian core staying near 2%, labor weakness dominating activity 66, and energy pass-through remaining a minutes risk rather than a reaction-function input. historical_reference.distribution: CA 2Y 3.27 sits at 97.8th 1y / only 58.5th 5y (z 2.46 1y, 0.15 5y): a 1y stretch, not a 5y blow-off. 1m +31bp is a discovery flag. analogs: Closest packet analog for CA 2Y after a +31bp 1m backup is 2022-06-30 (level 3.10, same prior 1m +31bp): next 1m 0bp, next 3m +66bp as BoC kept hiking into a global tightening/energy regime. 2023-04-14 (level 3.81, prior 1m +31bp) then -1bp 1m / +83bp 3m. Those episodes say a 1m Canada backup during global tightening was not the end of the hike cycle. Counter-analog: 2026-04-01 (level 2.82, prior 1m +31bp) then +12bp 1m / -6bp 3m, a fade. US 2Y +57bp analogs are mixed (2022-03-23 continued higher; 2023-02-16 reversed), which is why the US 100th-percentile screen is not the trade.
historical_reference.regime_differences: 2022 analogs started from a broader CPI shock and a hiking cycle off emergency lows; today CORRA is already 2.29, Canada core is near 2%, and labor 38/consumer 45 are genuine soft spots. 2026 also has a Saudi Oman workaround that modestly eased oil after the East-West pipeline attack, which 2022 did not. Similarities that still hold: Fed tightening delivered, energy prices at the top of the 1y distribution, and Canada activity not in collapse. The 2026-04 fade analog had no just-delivered Fed hike and no 99th-percentile Brent print.

revised_trade.thesis: FACT: Global tightening is live (Fed +25bp, BoJ to 1.25%, BoE 6-3 with three hike votes) while US growth gauges and cyclical assets (copper, SPX, tight HY, low VIX) are not in recession. Canada is priced as the exception: CORRA 2.29, 1m path +29bp by year-end, and a 17 Sep sovereign rally. INFERENCE: energy pass-through plus activity 66 make that exception too large; Mar-27 CORRA should move toward the already-higher Jun/Sep 2027 CRA mids as BoC catch-up is pulled forward. That is the pro-growth/cyclical expression: the laggard cyclical central bank, not long AUD after a housing slump or long NZD with labor 32 and no NZ rates. UNKNOWN: whether Saudi supply workaround and core-near-2% CPI let BoC wait through Q1.
revised_trade.mispricing: Market prices an on-hold BoC into October and only ~one 25bp by Dec-26 on 1m CORRA, with Mar-27 3m at 3.13. That is too little catch-up versus a delivered Fed hike, Brent/WTI at the top of the 1y distribution, and Canada activity that has not collapsed. CA 2Y 5y percentile 58.5 shows the cheapness is the path/level versus the US and versus energy, not a 5y yield extreme to fade.
